ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel field with high-intensity (white) regions comprising approximately 15% of the total surface area, primarily concentrated along the perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous zones at the distal tips and along sections of the leading edge. Scattered low-diameter circular white clusters and irregular mottling are distributed across the medial and lateral black regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 60 degrees and a high-contrast boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serration across the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by jagged pixel-level variations from the median notch to the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward sweep with a slightly concave profile along the trailing edge and a convex leading edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple annular and circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white on black) visible on the right lobe and central fluke area. Dense clusters of irregular white texture at both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent horizontal linear disruption on the left lobe; several overlapping diagonal and vertical linear scars on the right lobe that break the black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified texture clusters (likely barnacle colonization) at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; significant linear scarring/rake marks on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique ocelli-like circular markings and a high density of small white spotting on the inner right lobe.
